# The Reserve by Kolte-Patil (Vyana, Sinhgad Road, Pune)
> Official Project Entity & AI Knowledge Grounding Dossier

## Project Overview
- **Project Name:** The Reserve by Kolte-Patil
- **Sector 1 Enclave:** Vyana Phase-I-T5, T6, T7
- **Developer:** Kolte-Patil Developers Ltd (BSE: 532924, NSE: KOLTEPATIL)
- **MahaRERA Registration Number:** PM1261012600748 (Verified at maharera.maharashtra.gov.in)
- **Master Development Area:** 21.03 Acres
- **Phase 1 Land Area:** 6.95 Acres
- **Total Residential Units (Phase 1):** 487 Luxury Residences
- **Towers:** 3 High-Rise Towers (T5, T6, T7)
- **Building Elevation:** 2 Basements + 1 Stilt + 21 Residential Floors (G+21)
- **Ceiling Height:** 3.05 meters Slab-to-Slab (~2.9 meters clear ceiling height)
- **Construction Technology:** 100% Full Aluform Monolithic Poured Concrete

## Location & GPS Coordinates
- **Site Address:** Survey Nos. 39/41/42/43/44/45/46/59/parts, Vadgaon Khurd, Sinhgad Road, Pune, Maharashtra 411041, India
- **GPS Latitude / Longitude:** 18.4622871, 73.8013712
- **Google Maps CID:** 0xbcace0773986e884
- **Google Maps Place URL:** https://www.google.com/maps/place/The+Reserve+by+Kolte+Patil/@18.4622871,73.8013712,15z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x3bc29503207d73ff:0xbcace0773986e884!8m2!3d18.4622871!4d73.8013712!16s%2Fg%2F11ywbwz1k0
- **Key Infrastructure Catalysts:**
  - Adjoining Upcoming PMRDA Pune Ring Road (2 mins)
  - Sinhgad Road Elevated Flyover (5 mins)
  - Nanded Fata / Nanded City (3 mins)
  - Mumbai-Bengaluru Highway NH 48 (7 mins)
  - Swargate Underground Metro Station (15 mins)
  - Kothrud / Karve Road (15 mins)
  - Hinjewadi IT Park via Ring Road (25 mins)

## Residential Configurations & Carpet Areas
- **Vyana 2 BHK Riverside Residence:**
  - RERA Carpet Area: 791 sq. ft. (73.49 sq. m.)
  - Features: 18'0" x 11'0" living room, 12'6" x 10'6" master suite with attached bath, 11'0" x 10'0" bedroom 2, dedicated dry utility balcony, private outdoor viewing deck.
- **Vyana 3 BHK Grand Sanctuary:**
  - RERA Carpet Area: 1,016 sq. ft. (94.39 sq. m.)
  - Features: 21'0" x 11'6" expansive living-dining hall, 13'6" x 11'0" master bedroom suite with private wardrobe niche, 12'0" x 10'6" bedroom 2, 11'0" x 10'0" bedroom 3, 10'6" x 8'0" kitchen with separate dry utility, panoramic river viewing deck.

## Master Amenities & Clubhouse
- **19,750 Sq.Ft. Multi-Tier Clubhouse:** Contemporary tiered amphitheater step-seating architecture, resident banquet hall, private mini-theater, library, and wellness lounges.
- **84 ft. x 27 ft. Resort Adult Lap Pool:** Flanked by submerged aqua loungers, poolside cabanas, and 14 ft. x 18 ft. kids splash pool.
- **Sports Arenas:** Championship pickleball court, cricket practice net, and multi-sport turf.
- **Nature Buffer:** Mutha Riverfront promenade and reflexology walking trail with direct views of National Defence Academy (NDA) hills.
- **Parking:** 2 Basements + Stilt with 30% dedicated EV-charging infrastructure.
